coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO, .nvchecker.toml, and papirus-folders.hook due to LLM API HTTP 400 errors.
learnings: When a model encounters transient API errors on specific files, the audit tool should either retry the request or gracefully degrade by evaluating the successfully reviewed files, rather than forcing an overall inconclusive verdict if another model has already provided full coverage.
